> Web › patient-mobile › docs · hóa đơn, hướng dẫn đã gửi, đơn đã duyệt; chỉ xem

## Logic source
- Web: patient-mobile › docs · hóa đơn, hướng dẫn đã gửi, đơn đã duyệt; chỉ xem
- Web `prototype/patient-mobile` + `prototype/shared/patient.js`.
- Web `patient.js` › docs(); approved items only, read-only.

## KMP
- Route: `Routes.PatientDocuments` ("patient-documents") · app bar "Tài liệu & hóa đơn"
- Composable: `PatientDocumentsScreen` — `pema-kmp/feature/billing/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/pema/clinic/feature/billing/PatientDocuments.kt`
- Registered by graph: `patientDocumentsGraph`
- `shared/clinic` domain functions imported by the file (shared by every screen in it): `careFinanceSummary`, `money`, `patient`, `viDate`
- Shot test: `pema-kmp/feature/billing/src/jvmTest/kotlin/com/pema/clinic/feature/billing/PatientDocumentsShotTest.kt:9` → `pema-kmp/feature/billing/build/shots/K2-vs.png`
